title: feat(list): no Actions column on the list page; a selection swaps the page bar; lists load as they scroll
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEV9LRY8FfTWS7J6T3MwsSL)_

Fixes #35554

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb8qTxAVaE2QKwquQU

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表页不再有「操作」列，行尾也没有悬停 ⋮；勾选后页面栏换成「商机 / 已选 N 条」+「取消」+ 前两个操作，其余进 ⋮。
- 右键菜单与 ⋮ 同一组操作，「删除」放最后、分隔线后、红色；整个勾选格可点，Shift 连选。
- 没声明 `pagination` 的表格视图改为滚动加载（每次 50），总数显示在视图名旁（服务器总数），点进记录再返回会回到原位置；声明了 `pagination` 的视图照旧翻页。
- 不在列表页的表格（相关列表、页面块、记录抽屉）保留操作列和底部批量栏作为兜底。

## What changes

**No Actions column on the list page; the selection swaps the page bar** (items 1–3)
- `plugin-grid/src/listPageBarSlot.ts` (new): a small external store. The page bar registers a slot element and the scope it speaks for (its page column); a grid whose root sits inside that scope portals its selection UI into the slot and reports `selecting`. Rendered by `app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, which shows a selection face 「对象名 / 已选 N 条」 in the 44px bar while rows are ticked and hides the regular `PageHeader`. No change to `ObjectView.tsx`.
- `plugin-grid/src/components/SelectionPageBar.tsx` (new): count, Cancel, the actions for the selection. One record ⇒ that row's own actions (the same plan its menu resolves); two or more ⇒ the bulk actions. The first two are buttons, in declared order (the object's `list_item` actions are sorted by `order` when assembled; with no `order`, the first two as declared), the rest behind "⋮"; Delete is never a button. With every loaded row ticked and more matching, it offers 「已选当前加载的 N 条。」 + 「选择全部 M 条」 (the existing select-all-matching fan-out and its 5000 cap).
- `ObjectGrid.tsx`: inside a page-bar scope the grid draws no `_actions` column (`objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` `drawRowControls`) and no bottom `BulkActionBar`. **Fallback, as ruled:** a grid in no page bar's scope (related lists, page blocks, the record drawer, any host without the Console header) keeps its Actions column and its bottom bulk bar unchanged.

**Context menu** (item 4) — `RowActionMenu.tsx` / `RowContextMenu.tsx` / `BulkActionBar.tsx`: Delete is the last item, after a separator, in `text-destructive`; a selection's menu closes with its destructive bulk actions the same way (`orderSelectionMenuItems`).

**Checkbox cell and Shift** (item 5) — `components/.../data-table.tsx`: the whole leading cell already toggled the row; Shift+click now extends from the last toggled row over the rows between (multiple selection only).

**Scroll loading and the count** (item 6) — `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (paging/count plumbing only) + `plugin-grid/src/objectGridInfiniteLoad.ts` (new):
- A grid list whose view declares no `pagination` (spec `pagination` is optional with no default, so its presence is the declaration) draws no pager. It loads 50 rows, and the next 50 (`$top=50&$skip=50`) when the table's scroll box comes within 320px of its end; a box with no height (hidden, not laid out) asks for nothing.
- The count beside the view name is the server's `total` of matching rows (not the rows loaded): the view switcher's count from #35548, fed through `toolbarLeading`'s `recordCount`, which under scroll loading is the find's total.
- Coming back: the scroll position and the rows held are kept in `sessionStorage` per list address; on return the list reads those windows back and restores the position once they are drawn.
- Re-reading held windows (the return above, and a refresh after a write with several windows loaded) is one request per 50-row window, in parallel — never one read of every held row: a host caps a read's `$top` (`OS_DATA_MAX_PAGE_SIZE`) and refuses a read over it with 400 `MAX_RECORDS_EXCEEDED` (L1 M1).
- A view that declares `pagination` keeps its pager exactly as before. Footer totals stay server-computed over every matching row.

**i18n** — new keys in all 11 packs: `grid.selectedCount` (plural family), `grid.selectedAllLoaded` (plural family), `grid.selectAllTotal`. zh-Hant regenerated from zh-Hans.

## Tests

New
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/listPageBarSlot-35554.test.tsx` (7): no `_actions` column in a page-bar scope + CONTROL with none; one row selected exposes the record's first two actions, the rest in ⋮, no bottom bar; two rows show the bulk actions and Cancel restores; CONTROL bottom bar without a page bar; Shift range; right-click Delete last after the separator.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.infiniteRereadPageCap-35554.test.tsx` (2): a data source that refuses `$top` over one window, as a capped host does; coming back to a kept position over 110 rows, and a refresh with three windows held, each re-read as `$skip` 0 / 50 / 100 with `$top` 50 and all 120 rows back.
- `ui/e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts` (16, Chromium): the real `ObjectViewPageHeader`, view-bar switcher, `ListView`, `ObjectGrid` and zh-Hans pack bundled from source, 120 rows paged by `$skip`/`$top`, at 1280×800 and 1167×762 — no column / no hover control and the last column fully visible; 「已选 2 条」 with nothing floating over the rows; one vs two selected expose different actions; right-click ends with separator + 「删除」; no pager, scroll loads to 100, switcher count 120, 「选择全部 120 条」; remount lands with 商机 60 in view; declared `pagination` still pages; light/dark screenshots.

Migrated (behaviour changed by this card)
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardRowActions-29150.test.tsx`, `rowContextMenu-28434.test.tsx` — expected item order: Delete moves from second to last.
- `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.bulkWiredHeaderDuplicate-12462.test.tsx` — reads the selection's actions from the page bar (exposed buttons + ⋮) instead of `bulk-actions-bar`; Clear → Cancel. Same assertions on which actions are carried.
- `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx` — open the row's menu by right-click (the row has no ⋮ on the list page); same items asserted.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.calendarDateWindow-12081.test.tsx` — the paged-grid CONTROL now declares `pagination: {}` (a grid without it loads as it scrolls).
- `ui/e2e/live/action-modal.spec.ts`, `list-row-action-cel.spec.ts`, `screen-flow.spec.ts` (Live E2E UI) — open the row's menu by right-clicking the first row instead of its ⋮; same items asserted.

Retired: none.

## Acceptance notes

- Checklist items edited (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`): `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` rev 11 (steps[4], acceptance[3] clause + verify: scroll loading vs a declared pager; steps[8]: bulk actions in the page bar), `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` rev 10 (steps[0–2], acceptance[0]: the page bar's 「选择全部 M 条」 offer), `records-forms.v18-semantic-defaults` rev 8 (acceptance[1]: "first window").
- Exposed actions: one record exposes its declared `list_item` actions first, then the built-in Edit when there is room; Delete is never exposed. Bulk exposes the first two non-destructive bulk actions.
- Locales other than en / zh-Hans / zh-Hant reuse their "on this page" wording for 「已选当前加载的 N 条」.
- Twenty (AGPL) was used as a reference for structure and sizes only; no code was read or copied.

## Verification

- vitest after merging `origin/main` (e01b8bed): plugin-grid + plugin-list + i18n + components table renderers 6641 (6628 passed, 13 skipped, 0 failed); app-shell list/page-header files 1781/1781; other packages' tests that pin the changed testids or mount `ListView` (194 files) 4529 (4517 passed, 12 skipped, 0 failed); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 5094 (5092 passed, 2 skipped).
- After the M1 fix (2a4b0b4d): `packages/plugin-list` 1890/1890 (178 files); Playwright `e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts` 16/16. CI green on 2a4b0b4d (Test UI 16 shards, Test Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, TypeScript Type Check, Lint & Repo Gates; mergeable clean).
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob each time): `drawRowControls` forced `true` ⇒ the no-column pin goes red; the page-bar slot forced `null` ⇒ 4 selection pins go red; the multi-window re-read forced back to one `$top = rows held` read ⇒ both re-read pins go red.
- `tsc` for plugin-grid, plugin-list, app-shell and `tsconfig.e2e.json`; `check:test-source-alias`, `check:platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`, `check:nul-bytes`, and the 48 other `dispatch-gates --commands` lines, all exit 0; `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` clean against main and #35634 / #35622.
